bio.text: Charlie McClintock, a Republican, represents District 42 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists McClintock as serving a second Senate term after one term in the Iowa House.

The biography lists McClintock as a 911 manager for the Cedar Rapids Police Department, a former Cedar Rapids police officer and a former warrant officer in the Iowa Army National Guard, where McClintock served 21 years; it also says McClintock was an Alburnett City Council member and mayor.
It lists a B.S. from the University of Phoenix and an M.B.A. from Liberty University, both in criminal justice administration, and says McClintock was born in 1970 in Newton and lives in Alburnett.
